mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at 0.09% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy at the zero lower bound
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL index exceeds 225, it signals persistent inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS (both below their 3-month moving averages) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to weak consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO and GDPC1 (both below their 6-month moving averages) fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The current employment level (PAYEMS at 131017.0 thousand) signals a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is above 130000.0 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550.0 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market that supports consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 550.0.
